page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a decorative woodcut border and title at the top; a large woodcut initial opens the verse. No margin notes; no running head; page number at top right.

main_text.l: Raptum per altos me feret ætheris
Heu, heu, Britannis quanta ferox tuis Miles

page.notes: The woodcut initial "O" is joined to "VAE" in the first line. The signature at the foot of the verse ("A. ý") is a printed sign/initial and is transcribed as shown; it is uncertain. Line-initial "V" forms in "Vt", "Vrbesque" and "Vae" are printed as V and kept. Some long-s forms in the scan (e.g. "feftas") are read as plain s. "Quum" and "Qui" in the second and fourth stanzas are printed with an underline below the initial letters in the scan; not reproduced. The word "Constrauit" may be "Constrauit" as printed; uncertain at the scan resolution [?]. Word "Argolicis" line ending is clear.
